description: We are VEGA which is the brightest star in the northern constellation of Lyra. At NASA Space Apps 2026. Our mission is to help make exploring the lunar moon for students, researchers and people who are curious about space, easier using NASA data. We have created interactive tools to predict outcomes on the moon, and we aim towards making future visits to the moon possible, that is our mission.
summary: VEGAMOON brings lunar exploration and mission planning together in one interactive platform. Users can explore the Moon through a 3D map, select landing locations, and experience the lunar surface from an astronaut’s perspective. Our platform also allows users to compare sunlight and Earth-related conditions through interactive graphs, while JPL Horizons-based timelines help visualize how astronomical conditions change over time. To make the experience more accessible, we created Moony, a virtual assistant that guides users through the website. Our creativity lies in combining exploration, scientific visualization, time-based analysis, and interactive guidance to make lunar landing-site investigation more understandable and engaging.
details:
Vega Moon is an interactive lunar exploration and mission-planning platform designed to simplify the complex process of evaluating landing sites and environmental conditions on the Moon. Developed in response to NASA’s challenge of assessing lighting and communication conditions at the lunar south pole, Vega Moon transforms complex lunar information into an accessible, visual, and interactive experience for mission planners, researchers, educators, and the public.

How It Works

The platform combines interactive 3D lunar visualization, astronomical information, and user-guided exploration to help users understand the Moon’s environment and the challenges of lunar missions.

Its main features include

Interactive 3D Moon Map: A navigable 3D lunar globe that allows users to explore the lunar surface, select specific locations, and examine the lunar environment from the perspective of their chosen location

Moony – Interactive Assistant: An integrated assistant that guides users through the platform, explains its features, and makes complex lunar information easier to understand

Earth–Moon Illumination Visualization: A visual comparison of Earth and Moon illumination, helping users understand the relationship between sunlight, lunar conditions, and the Earth–Moon system

Astronomical Data Visualization: The platform is designed to help users explore how celestial positions and lighting conditions change over time, supporting the evaluation of different lunar landing scenarios.

Technology and Development

Vega Moon is developed as an interactive web-based application, combining 3D lunar visualization, astronomical data, and user-friendly interface design. Its approach draws on NASA lunar exploration resources and astronomical data to make complex scientific information more accessible.

Impact and Benefits

Vega Moon aims to bridge the gap between complex scientific tools and accessible lunar exploration technology. By bringing lunar visualization, astronomical information, and guided exploration into one platform, it helps users understand the challenges of lunar mission planning and explore potential landing environments more intuitively.

Ultimately, Vega Moon seeks to make lunar exploration more understandable, interactive, and accessible while supporting the broader goal of safer and more informed future missions to the Moon.
